documents.title: Driving license application procedure (सवारी चालक अनुमतिपत्र)
documents.text: Driving license applications in Nepal are submitted online through the Department of Transport Management apply portal. Steps: fill the online form, choose the license office and exam date, print the submission receipt, take the written (likhit) exam on the scheduled date, pass the practical (व्यावहारिक) trial after a waiting period, then collect the license. Age requirement: 18 years for motorcycles/cars (16 with guardian consent for up to 125cc motorcycle), 21 for professional/public vehicles. Required documents: citizenship certificate, medical certificate for categories A2 and above, and eye test where applicable.

documents.title: License fees and validity
documents.text: Department of Transport Management fee schedule: written exam application fee Rs. 500 (motorcycle category A), practical test fee Rs. 1,000-2,500 depending on category, license printed card fee Rs. 1,500. Learner license validity: 1 year from written exam pass. Renewal fee: Rs. 2,000 per 5-year cycle for private categories. Fines for expired license renewal: Rs. 50 per month late fee after expiry (as per current notice — confirm at dotm.gov.np).
